title: output.verifiable_receipts output (Receipt)
description: Signed output-attestation receipt (catalog shape `Receipt`; mirrors the `output_attest` tool result's `manifest` object). Advertise-only per RCX Session-Handshake v1; the field set is open (additive).

spec_version.description: C2PA spec version the manifest targets.

manifest_jumbf_base64.description: The signed manifest envelope, base64-encoded JUMBF.

content_hash_blake3_hex.description: Lowercase hex of the 32-byte BLAKE3 hash of the attested content bytes.

crown_receipt_id.description: Id of the CROWN receipt anchoring this attestation.

signer_key_id.description: Key id the manifest was signed with.

signer_alg.description: Signature algorithm, e.g. ed25519 or ES256.

verify_url.description: Best-effort URL for re-verifying the manifest against the issuing daemon.
